usageNotes: Use this to enumerate SDN zones across one or more PDM-managed remotes, optionally filtered by zone type or scoped to specific remotes. By default the response reflects the running configuration; pass `pending: true` to surface unapplied changes, or `running: false` to see the pending-only view. Only zones from remotes where the caller holds `Resource.Audit` on `/resource/{remote_name}` are returned, so a partial result set is normal in multi-tenant environments.

examples.summary: List all EVPN zones with pending-change details across a specific remote

tips: The `state` field on each returned zone (`new`, `deleted`, `changed`) indicates SDN objects that have been modified but not yet applied — useful for detecting drift before running an SDN apply operation.

Use `ty` to narrow large environments; scanning all zones across many remotes without a type filter can return a verbose payload with many zone-type-specific fields that will be null for non-matching types.
Each result includes a `remote` field identifying which PDM remote the zone belongs to, making cross-remote aggregation straightforward without additional lookups.
EVPN zones carry BGP-specific fields (`controller`, `vrf-vxlan`, `exitnodes`, `rt-import`) that are absent on simpler zone types — check the `type` field before accessing these properties.
